decisions: Capture range endpoint at initialization and decide last item from current cursor, preserving exclusive admission and take termination. Keep afterEach destination when inner range completes. Wrapped next must not be selected for another iteration.

Console i32 ABI is signed. Shared integerConsoleWidth selects unsigned i64 for UInt32. Entry/function/region/readonly-reference paths preserve canonical signedness and proper argument ABI, with no change to Bool/narrow/signed output.

CSharp11 precede qualification. Old scalar flatMap expected4 preparation failed; declared scalar outer contract proves expected2 and separate mapped outer control yields4. Warning source preimage preserved, contextual0 verified.

+# As in C# Range each, decide completion from the current item. The computed
+# next value is never selected after the last inclusive endpoint.
+emitEntryRangeAdvance terminal: Int, inner: Bool -> Unit uses Console {
+    inner -> if { "_inner" } else { "" } => suffix
+    "  %stream$(terminal)$(suffix)_current = load i32, ptr %stream$(terminal)$(suffix)_index_slot, align 4" -> println

+    "  store i32 %stream$(terminal)$(suffix)_next, ptr %stream$(terminal)$(suffix)_index_slot, align 4" -> println
+}
